title: Continuous Deep-Pitted Morel-Like Fungus
description: Original stylised morel-like fungus with a gently bent grounded stem continuously joined to an irregular tapered cap bearing sixty-five genuinely recessed blind polygon cells. Each cell has a narrow full raised rim, sloping inner walls and a real finite brown floor. The irregular periodic cell partition changes both cell adjacency and outline; no repeated horizontal rectangular window rows, painted holes or floating tubes. One closed shared-vertex mesh and four opaque matte PBR materials. This is a substantive visual revision of the unpublished first image, which was rejected for manufactured window-grid appearance; it is the same single asset, not an extra variant. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Static artistic external structure only, not species identification, biological hollow interior, scientific specimen, growth/physics, foraging or edibility advice.
